Description
The 2020 silver coins from Barbados primarily refer to the popular 1 oz Silver Trident series, the fourth release, featuring the national coat of arms (obverse) and a trident (reverse), with a low mintage of 30,000 and a $1 face value, made by Scottsdale Mint. Other 2020 issues include the spherical “Planet Earth” (3 oz silver with blue enamel) and various “Shapes of America” coins, highlighting Barbados’s partnership with mints like Scottsdale for unique, collectible silver legal tender
Design of 1 oz Silver Coin – Barbados Silver Trident
Limited mintage of 30,000 coins.
Obverse: Displays the Barbados coat of arms, the national symbol featuring fist of a Barbadian holding two stalks of sugar cane. Upon the shield are a pair of the national flowers, known as the Pride of Barbados, and a single bearded fig tree. The shield is supported by a dolphin fish and a pelican. They stand for the fishing industry and Pelican Island, respectively.
Reverse: Features the trident symbol as it appears on the Barbados national flag as well as the face value $1 and the year.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Silver Coin – Barbados Silver Trident
Contains 1 oz of .999 fine Silver.
Each coin comes in protective plastic capsule.
Limited mintage of 30,000 coins.
Obverse: Displays the Barbados coat of arms, the national symbol featuring fist of a Barbadian holding two stalks of sugar cane. Upon the shield are a pair of the national flowers, known as the Pride of Barbados, and a single bearded fig tree. The shield is supported by a dolphin fish and a pelican. They stand for the fishing industry and Pelican Island, respectively.
Reverse: Features the trident symbol as it appears on the Barbados national flag as well as the face value and the year.
Both obverse and reverse rims feature wavy radial lines making the coins harder to duplicate and provide a measure of security.
This coin is manufactured and distributed by Scottsdale Mint and is a legal tender in the country of Barbados.
